translation.name: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau
translation.englishName: Kilivila: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau Bible

content: Aisake isaiki kala kabwaila Yekobe
Baisa tuta Aisake bogwa eitomoya, e eikau wala. E idou molitomoya Iso iluki matauna, kawala, “Mwa! Latugʹo.” E ivitakauloki, kawala, “Mayeigu ka.”
Aisake ikaibiga, kawala, “Ka, bogwa latomoya, e kaina makateki bakaliga.
Mapaila kukwau m kwaiyala, e kula olawodila kubasi natana agu bolodila.
E oluvi kusulu kʹagu kwaitala kalumatabwaila e kumai bakam. Oluvi basakaim kam kwabwaila, paila ulo kaliga makateki wala.”
Aisake ililivala makawala baisa Iso mitaga Ribeka bogwa inakaigali. E tutala Iso isunapula bila iwaiga,
e minana iluki Yekobe, kawala, “Ka, bogwa lalagi tamam iluki Iso, kawala
‘Kumai agu bolodila e kusulu paila yeigu. Tutala bakam biwokuva, e basakaim kam kwabwaila, paila makateki bakaliga wala.? ??
E Ribeka ikaibiga, kawala, “E latugu, ka, ibodi bukulagi bukuvagi avaka balukwaim.
Kula mayuwona gota bukunagi nayu nagugugwadi napusoposa, e kumai basulu kʹala tamam kalumatabwaila.
E ibodi bukuuyoki tamam bikam e bisakaim kam kwabwaila e bikaligaga.”
Mitaga Yekobe iluki inala, kawala, “Ka yoku kunikoli matauna Iso tounuunu, mitaga yeigu todudubuna.
Kaina tamagu bikabikonaigu e binikoli lasipuloki matauna, e makawala goli bogwa babani agu bolata, gala wala agu kwabwaila bakau.”
Mitaga inala ivitakaula, kawala, “Kidamwa bisakaim kam bolata, ka latugu, yeigu bakeula agu pakula mabigasina. Desi wala. Yokugwa kuvagi wala avaka lalukwaim. Kula kumai minasina gota baisa yeigu.”
E mapaila ila wala imai minasina gota isaiki inala, e minana isulu kʹala tamala kalumatabwaila.
E minana eisisia Iso kala kakapula yaminabwaita ola bwala. Mapaila imai miyana ivisikoma Yekobe.
E ivisikoma minasina gota kanuvinesi oyamala Yekobe, e deli isaili okaigadula ambaisa gala unuunula.
E minana isaiki Yekobe kʹala tamala kalumatabwaila, deli makwaina kaula eisulu makateki.
E Yekobe ilokaia tamala, kawala, “Tamagu.” E ivitakauloki, kawala, “Mayeigula. Ka litugwa taiyu, e avai taugwa yoku?”

E Yekobe ivitakauloki matauna, kawala, “Yeigula latum Iso molitomoya. Ka bogwa lavagi makawala kulukwaigu. Anigadaim kusimalaula kukwam kam viliona avaka lamiakaim, e mapaila gagabila bukusakaigu agu kwabwaila.”
E Aisake ikaibiga, kawala, “Mwa! Latugu, ammakawalaga saina nanakwa lokubani agu bolodila?” E Yekobe ivitakaula kawala, “Guyau m Yaubada ipilasaigu e bogwa labani.”
E Aisake iluki Yekobe, kawala, “Anigadaim kusimada bakabikonaim. Ki mokwitala yoku Iso?”
Yekobe isimada okaipapala tamala, e Aisake ikabakakavi, kawala, “Kaigam makawala Yekobe, yamamgwa makawala Iso.”
Aisake gala wala binikoli Yekobe, paila yamala saina unuunula makawala Iso yamala. E makateki bisaiki kala kabwaila,
mitaga ikatupoivau, kawala, “Ki mokwita goli yoku Iso, ke?” E ivitakaula, kawala, “Yeigu goli.”
Aisake ikaibiga, kawala, “Kumai sitana agu viliona bakam. Oluvi goli basakaim kam kwabwaila.” Yekobe imiaki matauna, e tuvaila imai sitana kala waini.
E tamala iluki matauna, kawala, “Latugu kusimada kuviyuwolaigu.”

Yekobe ima biviyuwoli, e Aisake isikoni maiinela kala kakapula, e mauula isaiki kala kabwaila. Ikaibiga, kawala, “Latugu, maiinela saina simasimina wowom, makawala maiinela bagula makwaina Guyau eimitukwaii.
Ibodi Yaubada bivinumli m bagula kidamwa bikabinai sainela. Ibodi tomota bimitukwaiyaim bisakaim kaula deli waini saina bidugaga.

Ibodi tomota ituwoli bona ituwoli bona biwotitalaimsi e deli bikavaginasi baisa omatam. Ibodi bisim m kwaraiwaga baisa dalem komwaidona. Availa availa bisakaimsi kam bolata, ibodi bibanaisi kasi bolata. Availa availa bisakaimsi kam kwabwaila, ibodi bibanaisi kasi kabwaila.”
Iso iyokakapisi mwada Aisake bisaiki kala kabwaila
Aisake ivenoku kala kabwaila Yekobe, e Yekobe isunapula. E matutona tuwala Iso isuvi imai kala bolodila tumasi.
E matauna tuvaila isulu kʹala tamala kalumatabwaila, e imiaki tamala. Kawala, “Tamagu, ka anigadaim kusimalaula kukwam kam viliona avaka lamiakaim, e gagabila bukusakaigu agu kwabwaila.”
E Aisake ikatupoi, kawala, “Availaga yoku?” E ivitakaula, kawala, “Yeigula latum molitomoya Iso.”

Aisake ivitouula itatatuva wowola deli la nokubukubu sainela, e ikatupoi, kawala, “Availaga matauna makateki ikatumati agu bolodila e imiakaigu? Paila igau gala bukusuvi, lakambogwa. Paila bogwa lasaiki iyavila ulo kabwaila baisa matauwena. Matauna goli eikoumkulovi kala kabwaila gala biwokuva, bikanigaga goli.”
Tutala Iso ilagi baisa, iuwakula kaigala kaigaveka nanola saina mmayuyu e ikaibiga, kawala, “Tamagʹo, yeigu tuvaila. Bukusakaigu agu kwabwaila.”
Aisake ivitakaula, kawala, “Wo, bodam leima eisipulokaigu. Bogwa eikau kam kwabwaila.”
Iso ikaibiga, kawala, “Ka, tuta baisa siviyuwela eisipulokaigu. Ka mokwitatoula matauna yagala Yekobe.
Ikugwa eikau ulo kaikeya yeigu molitomoya, e tuta baisa ikau agu kwabwaila. Ki gala kwaitala kuyosi agu kwabwaila?”

Aisake ivitakaula, kawala, “Mwa! Latugu, bogwa lakaraiwaga matauna biguyoi odabam, e deli veyala lavigaki la ula. E lasaiki kaula deli waini. E bogwa leiwokuva, gala avaka gagabila bavagi paila yoku.”
Mitaga Iso iyokakapisi baisa tamala, kawala, “Ki, tamagu, gala wala kwaitala kabwaila isisu, ke? Tamagʹo, kusakaigu agu kwabwaila tuvaila!” E ikapwali la koku ivalam.
E Aisake iluki matauna, kawala,

content.text: e m bagula gala wala bikabinai.
E avai tuta mwada bukukoulovi la karaiwaga,
E tuta matutona goli bogwa bukukwalisau.”

content: Iso saina igaga nanola baisa bodala paila uula tamala leisaiki Yekobe kala kabwaila. E ininamsi, kawala, “Makateki goli tamagu bikaliga, e yeigu bavalam. Mitaga tutala basimla, e bogwa bakatumati Yekobe.”
Mitaga tutala Ribeka ilagi Iso nanola, idou Yekobe iluki matauna, kawala, “Ka tuwam magila bikiduwosisii vavagi makwaina metoya om kwaliga.
Mapaila latugu, ka, ibodi bukuvagi avaka balukwaim. Bukunanakwa wala bukulokaia luguta Lebani mapilana Erana,
e bukusisu wala baisa, igau tutala biminumki nanola paila la gibuluwa tuwam,
e bilumwelavi baisa avaka lokuvigaki matauna. E oluvi bawitali availa biuyokaim biga, e bukukwaimilavau baisa. Ki, avakaga kala bwaina kidamwa kasitaiyu litugwa bibodasi kaliga yamla kwaitala wala?”
Aisake iwitali Yekobe bilokaia Lebani
Ribeka iluki Aisake, kawala, “Ka, bogwa lakamagwesi paila minasina vilesi kedakeda Iso la kukova. Kidamwa Yekobe tuvaila bivai natana minasina vilesi Itai, kaina bibodi yeigu bakaliga wala.”

footnotes.text: Maigana Yekobe kala lega makawala kwaiyu si biga mina Iberu. Kwaitala bogwa taginisi (kugisi Vit 25.26). E biga kwaiyuwela “tosasopa”.
